title: Compare verified single-label runs on identical populations

context.use: Read the entire linked section; normative details override this task summary.

outcome: Default comparison pairs identical selected populations and exposes changes without an overall winner.

artifacts.purpose: Reuse the existing private atomic no-replace publisher for comparison.json
Verify two runs and publish comparison

interfaces: Input: two verified validated evaluations/reports plus caller-supplied comparison identity.
Require equal golden digest/task/ordered labels/roles/numerical semantics/selected IDs.
Typed metric pairs preserve both statuses, candidate-minus-baseline delta only if both defined, and metric direction.
acceptance_criteria: All four correctness categories and changed outcomes have exact IDs/counts; full typed class+abstention transition matrix sums to N.
Source IDs remain local to each side; definition/configuration/observation/preparation differences are explicit even if IDs match.
Raw/final/probability families remain separate; answered-only comparisons disclose each answered population and overlap.
Comparison stores source run IDs/report hashes and returns receipt hashing comparison.json.

verification.expected: Recovered/regressed changes retained even with equal headline accuracy.
Incompatible pairs reject; undefined/macro/infinite metrics have null delta and reason.
One versioned receipt names/hashes actual comparison file.

verification_responsibility: A different agent from the implementation author reruns evidence and reviews every acceptance criterion; integrator accepts only the saved response.
common_completion_checks: All listed artifacts contain implemented behavior or required evidence; no placeholders.

All tests assigned to this task are listed by Cargo and execute with a nonzero expected test count. Compound conformance/structure cases have explicit later audit test owners in coverage.json; implementers still test each local invariant now.
Relevant fmt/Clippy/test/build checks pass on the pinned toolchain; no bypass, changed tolerance or weakened oracle.
Saved response records exact input/source/output hashes, commands, exit codes, expected/actual results, and unresolved failures.
New or changed-authority artifacts are indexed; operational state is updated in Fizzy after acceptance.
